title: Torsion dimension bound for ind-finite constructible hearts
statement: Fix a prime ℓ and a commutative condensed coefficient ring Λ isomorphic to one of A, Z_ℓ, O_E, Q_ℓ or E, using all continuous functions, where A is a finite discrete commutative ring killed by a power of ℓ and E/Q_ℓ is finite [sk-def-localizing-closure]. Let X be affine [def-pc-scheme], d a natural number, and suppose every affine etale V → X [def-weil-etale-morphism] has torsion etale cohomological dimension at most d [def-sc-etale-torsion-cd], for locally torsion sheaves without a common annihilator. Use the fixed small pro-etale site and universe [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention] and ordinary uncompleted internal module derived sections [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull, def-sfb-condensed-module-sections]. If M is an ambient small filtered colimit of finite constructible complex hearts [def-sfb-finite-constructible-complex-heart-presentations], then H^q(RΓ(X,M[0]))=0 for every integer q>d+2. Empty X and the zero coefficient ring are included. No Noetherian hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: For each finite-heart stage choose its finite constructible complex. Apply the finite-heart cohomological bound at the identity affine pro-etale test object and transport along upperStarId and the given heart isomorphism.
Apply condensedModuleSections_ind_isZero to the finite-heart property. The finite stages all have zero q-th derived sections cohomology, so filtered continuity makes the colimit cohomology zero.

lean.statement:
theorem torsionCd_indFiniteHeart_cohomology_vanishes
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    (hΛ :
      (∃ (A : Type) (_ : CommRing A) (_ : TopologicalSpace A)
          (_ : DiscreteTopology A) (_ : IsTopologicalRing A),
        Finite A ∧ (∃ n : ℕ, ∀ a : A, (ℓ ^ n) • a = 0) ∧
          Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj A))) ∨
      Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj ℤ_[ℓ])) ∨
      (∃ E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ,
        Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E))) ∨
      Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj ℚ_[ℓ])) ∨
      (∃ E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ,
        Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E))))
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X] (d : ℕ)
    (hcd : ∀ (V : Scheme.{u}) (v : V ⟶ X) [IsAffine V] [Etale v],
      V.HasTorsionEtaleCohomologicalDimensionLE d)
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))
    (hM : indFiniteConstructibleComplexHearts Λ X M)
    (q : ℤ) (hq : (d : ℤ) + 2 < q) :
    IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
      ((condensedModuleSections Λ X).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)))
